authority: Explicit human-owner request and boundary-scope clarification.
scope: Calls between approved components; not internal collaborator calls.
dapr_status: Accepted realization for service invocation; not mandatory or deployed.

rules.when: A call crosses an approved component boundary
rules.instruction: Route the call through a proxy implementing the reviewed component contract. Do not bypass the proxy because components share a process.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within system bounds

rules.instruction: Support dependency injection for the proxy and its required collaborators. Keep registration and lifetime selection in the composition root.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within system bounds

rules.instruction: Generate the typed proxy at build time. Use explicit typed forwarding to the approved implementation behind the boundary.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within system bounds

rules.instruction: Do not implement reflection-based proxy generation or dispatch. Do not use DispatchProxy, reflection emit, MethodInfo.Invoke, or equivalent runtime proxy machinery as a substitute for the required typed proxy.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within system bounds

rules.instruction: Use the approved service proxy or invocation boundary with DI-capable application-side wiring. A Dapr sidecar service-invocation route is an accepted realization.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within system bounds

rules.instruction: Resolve the caller-facing contract to the approved proxy chain. Do not expose a direct target registration to callers that bypasses that chain.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within system bounds

rules.instruction: Preserve allowed Method interactions, reviewed contract semantics, dependency lifetimes, cancellation, and failure behavior. A proxy does not authorize an otherwise prohibited call.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within system bounds

rules.when: A call remains inside one component
rules.instruction: Do not require a proxy solely because of this policy. Internal collaborator design remains within the reviewed component design.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within system bounds

rules.when: Changing proxy policy or generated inputs
rules.instruction: Escalate to the responsible architect. Workers cannot remove the proxy, weaken its checks, or amend upstream contracts to simplify implementation.
rules.decision_owner: Solution Architect; Application Architect within system bounds
